outcome: quality of labour and delivery (L&D) care
cohort: The cohort consisted of mothers who received routine labour and delivery care services at 20 government hospitals in the Southern Nations Nationalities and People's Region (SNNPR) of Ethiopia.
finding: The overall quality of routine labour and delivery care provided in government hospitals in Ethiopia's SNNPR was limited, with hospitals meeting on average two-thirds of standards (66.7%) and demonstrating substantial variation, particularly lacking in areas such as initial assessment, active management of the third stage of labour (AMTSL), and interpersonal communication.
